'''Voba Duey''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] criminal who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Someone took him. A big trandoshan. I think his name was Box. Or Bosch. Or, no, I got it...it was Bossk. He said he as a bounty hunter. He took Louis.|Voba Duey, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:B" />}}
[[File:VobaDuey2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Voba Duey, waiting near Kor Vella]]
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], she was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Meatlumps]], a gang of fanatic technology-hating thugs and terrorists, and worked under the orders of [[Louis Bender]], one the Meatlump leaders.<ref name="SWG:B" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Louis Bender planned to attack a delivery depot on the outskirts of the city of [[Kor Vella/Legends|Kor Vella]]. However, before the attack could happen, Louis Bender was captured by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]]. Louis ordered Voba Duey to "wait" while he was taken by the Trandoshan. A spacer affiliated with the Meatlumps later arrived in Kor Vella to assist Louis and Voba in the attack of the depot but only found the woman, still waiting. Duey reported the situation to the spacer who decided to rescue the Meatlump leader. The spacer eventually negotiated with Bossk the liberation of Louis Bender in exchange for the elimination of the [[Bofa Treat Gang]].<ref name="SWG:B" />

==Behind the scenes==
Voba Duey was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:B" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Voba Duey was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
